title: Patient history injected into reasoning prompt only

test_cases.name: History block in reasoning/diagnosis prompt
test_cases.expected_result: Prompt contains 'Patient History' header and history content

test_cases.name: History absent from extraction prompt
test_cases.expected_result: patient_history_text not a parameter; 'Patient History' not in output
test_cases.evidence: extraction prompt correctly excludes patient_history_text parameter

test_cases.name: SQL query interface unchanged from v3.3
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect check_history_usage() signature and sql/patient_history.sql presence
test_cases.expected_result: Functions exist with correct signatures; SQL file present

test_cases.name: No-history patient runs without crash
test_cases.input_setup: Pass empty visits list to format_history_for_prompt and check_history_usage
test_cases.expected_result: Returns empty string and history_provided=False; no exception
test_cases.evidence: Empty visit list handled gracefully; no crash; history_provided=False

test_cases.name: Long history (50 visits) formatted and injected without overflow
test_cases.input_setup: Build 50 synthetic visits; call format_history_for_prompt then get_diagnosis_prompt
test_cases.expected_result: Prompt contains all 50 lines; total prompt < 80 KB
test_cases.evidence: 50-visit history formatted into 50 lines; prompt 6613 chars
